description: A placed macro reading a skipped deliverable: quoted_review is chosen on a new visit, so it reads
deliverable.review_summary.content while review_summary is skipped by its if. Today the macro's
render fails ('Cannot get the member deliverable.review_summary.content for a null object') and
the job fails: echoes, which places it, and signed_only, released after it, are unsettled; the
rest are composed as in new-visit-defaults.
